## Constraints

### Must

- Colors, radii, fonts, shadows and durations come only from design/tokens.css; scripts/token-audit.ts enforces it.
- Text smaller than 18px never uses --ink-muted; red text on blush uses --red-deep.
- Durations stay at or below 300ms and prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions.
- Tap targets are at least 44px.

### Avoid

- The v2 poster system: Oswald, Playfair Display, paper grain, rotated stamps.
- Gradients other than the approved radial glow, glass effects and neon.
- New colors without an approved semantic token in design/tokens.css and design/tokens.json.

## Decisions

- The public product site adopts v3 Clean Premium EdTech: warm off-white space, Manrope display type, token-only soft cards, warm real photography, and red limited to primary actions and data accents.
- Lead forms keep the action primary and place explicit privacy consent immediately before submission.
- Legacy v2 class and variable names stay as a compatibility API but resolve only to v3 tokens (src/app/globals.css).
- The semantic success token (--success, --success-soft) marks correct answers in the quiz and review; approved by the owner on 2026-09-13.
